description: Vodovody - kapacity vodojemů, úpravny vody, voda vyrobená is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Český statistický úřad. The data set contains technical data on water tanks, water treatment plants and water produced. Coverage: Český statistický úřad. The portal shows the English title as "Water pipelines - capacity of water tanks, water treatment plants, water produced" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Český statistický úřad. Its keywords include voda vyrobená, úpravna vody, vodojem. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00025593/9e3ea11a727beec9039cd49c61a9b324/distribuce/0b7bc5585ceb6c5061d82418346a7b1f/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
